시편-34-2.title: 시편 34장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-34-2.exegesis: PSALM 34 Psa 34:1-22 . On the title compare 1Sa 21:13 . Abimelech was the general name of the sovereign ( Ge 20:2 ). After celebrating God's gracious dealings with him, the Psalmist exhorts others to make trial of His providential care, instructing them how to secure it. He then contrasts God's care of His people and His punitive providence towards the wicked. 1-4. Even in distress, which excites supplication, there is always matter for praising and thanking God (compare Ep 5:20 ; Php 4:6 ).

시편-34-9.exegesis: 8. taste and see-- try and experience.
시편-34-9.theologicalNote: 8. taste and see-- try and experience.

시편-34-10.title: 시편 34장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-34-10.exegesis: 9. that fear him-- who are pious--fear and love ( Pr 1:7 ; 9:10 ). saints-- consecrated to His service ( Is 40:31 ).
시편-34-10.theologicalNote: 9. that fear him-- who are pious--fear and love ( Pr 1:7 ; 9:10 ). saints-- consecrated to His service ( Is 40:31 ).

시편-34-11.title: 시편 34장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-34-11.exegesis: 10. not want any good-- "good" is emphatic; they may be afflicted (compare Psa 34:10 ); but this may be a good ( 2Co 4:17 , 18 ; He 12:10 , 11 ).
시편-34-11.theologicalNote: 10. not want any good-- "good" is emphatic; they may be afflicted (compare Psa 34:10 ); but this may be a good ( 2Co 4:17 , 18 ; He 12:10 , 11 ).

시편-34-13.title: 시편 34장 13절 역사문법적 주해
시편-34-13.exegesis: 12. What man-- Whoever desires the blessings of piety, let him attend.
시편-34-13.theologicalNote: 12. What man-- Whoever desires the blessings of piety, let him attend.

시편-34-14.title: 시편 34장 14절 역사문법적 주해
시편-34-14.exegesis: 13-14. Sins of thought included in those of speech ( Lu 6:45 ), avoiding evil and doing good in our relations to men are based on a right relation to God.
시편-34-14.theologicalNote: 13-14. Sins of thought included in those of speech ( Lu 6:45 ), avoiding evil and doing good in our relations to men are based on a right relation to God.
